meta.notes: Training 6, two pairs, two doors, one word: the white house (a door on two walls) in its garden, a grain store, three defenders. Regenerate: bun run tools/levels/export.ts train-pairs

lesson.title: Two pairs, two doors, one word

steps.line: Walk to the mark, short of the grain store
B on the grain store's door: all four stack up
F gives the word: all four go in
Walk back to the mark by the white house
When they call clear: X on the ground, then 3
Cursor on bare ground, then T: RED takes your orders
X on the red door, then 1: RED stacks up
T again, off the men: BLUE
B on the blue door: BLUE stacks up
Not F yet. T, off the men: GOLD, the whole squad
F gives the word: both pairs go in together
